svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two from 6 mm plate (jigsaw with a metal blade, or waterjet):

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: base 320 mm, 30 mm upright at each end, sloping sides up to a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: top 80 mm wide, 262 mm above the base.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Window: triangle 190 mm wide at 45 mm up, apex 155 mm up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Axle hole 21 mm, 230 mm up on the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bearing bolt holes 8.4 mm, 27 mm above and below the axle hole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Spacer rod holes 6.4 mm: 130 mm each side of centre, 18 up; and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Right frame only: 5.5 mm hole 175 mm up for the slip ring anchor.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Left frame only: M8 tapped hole 100 mm forward of and 100 mm below

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Also cut three spacer tubes 20 x 2 mm, 152 mm long; cut one of them

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: into two 63.5 mm halves for the front foot (the counter bar sits

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: between them). Check: both frames stand square on a flat bench.
